name: Composite Refactoring Sequence #2: Large-Scale Reorganization
description: Real-world example from Checkstyle: 34 Extract And Move Method refactorings

smells.description: Test class has 400+ lines with 30+ test methods
testGetChildren() is 120 lines with complex exception handling
High cyclomatic complexity in test setup (CC > 15)
Exception testing pattern repeated in 15+ test methods
Hardcoded index values (0, 1, 2) used throughout tests
Common exception testing logic should be a shared utility

refactoring_sequence: Move extracted helper to XPathTestUtil utility class
Extract similar exception handling from 33 other test methods
Move all extracted methods to centralized test utility
